items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 127:1
items.html: In the second aspect of the world of Assiyah, before the sin, when BYA ascended to Atzilut, except for the six lower ones of Assiyah, the holiness concluded at the Chazeh [chest] of Beriah, for these six upper ones of Beriah were in the secret of the expansion of the city, which is still considered as the city, that is, Atzilut. Therefore only twenty-four Sefirot remained as an empty void: the four lower [Sefirot] of Beriah and the twenty of Yetzirah and Assiyah. See above, answer 23. (Item 85).
